label: IGNIS is reading the studio

entries.title: The studio records the re-run settles it — the Lighthouse red was measured noise, not argued noise.
The studio tends cascade resync — regenerate feeds against the post-rebase HEAD.
The studio annotates closeout write-back — four gates that lied, two carries whose premises were wrong.
